analysis:
Reviewed all six batch analyses against the supplied replayed patches and metadata; no independently supported security regression was identified. Replay is incomplete (34 units omitted), so claims about unreplayed surrounding source remain unverified.

AppAttestKeyHistoryBuilder.swift:50, EnrollmentKeyLifecycle.swift:6, ShadowEnrollmentAttempt.swift:20 and AppAttestStallRestart.swift:130 replace Date ordering with equivalent signed-interval comparisons for finite timestamps. Equality, generation eligibility, future-transcript rejection, the 24-hour resumption bound and restart ordering are preserved. These local gates do not become serving authorization (A-015/A-016, TB-011, T-052/T-053/T-057). ClusterModelProvisioningStore.swift:164,193,230 likewise preserves retry and deadline thresholds; the patches do not change manifest acceptance or artifact identity controls (A-004, T-027).

.github/actions/provider-release-build/action.yml:354-367 adds a release-lane binary check covering the CLI, enclave, fan helper and cluster helpers; quoted paths and shell failure propagation are visible. ci.yml:149-155 adds checker tests and a source scan. Release/cache workflow path additions include checker changes in existing triggers. These support availability and artifact compatibility (A-018, A-017, T-054), without visibly changing authorization, encryption, plaintext exposure, billing or T-041 cache policy. Documentation describes compatibility rather than stronger attestation guarantees.

Remaining material review: inspect scripts/check-date-comparisons.py, scripts/check-provider-weak-imports.py and their tests to verify detection coverage and fail-closed parsing, and reconcile release-script/resumed-artifact enforcement with this composite action. The documented ClusterService.swift substitutions are not supplied for direct verification. Missing implementations do not establish a vulnerability, but leave the new compatibility safeguards and complete timing-change coverage unverified. No production qualification or full audit is established.
